WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_avg
  FROM status_averages
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT a.equipstatus, a.avg_pulse_rate,
         a.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_avg AS excess_first
  FROM status_averages AS a
  CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m
  WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_avg
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_avg
  FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
  SELECT k.avg_pulse_rate, k.excess_first,
         k.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_avg AS excess_second
  FROM first_kept AS k
  CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m
  WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_status_pulse_rate,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;

assumptions.assumption: Statuses with no non-NULL pulse rates are excluded from the status averages; each remaining status has equal weight when calculating each mean.
